# Lucide icons

Unmodified copies of the icons the WORKSPACE uses, from the npm package `lucide-static` version 0.460.0
(https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide-static@0.460.0/icons/). Project: https://lucide.dev, https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

License: ISC, see `LICENSE`. Copyright (c) for portions of Lucide are held by Cole Bemis 2013-2022 as part of
Feather (MIT). All other copyright (c) for Lucide are held by Lucide Contributors 2022.

Used as CSS masks from `site/workspace/style.css`. To add an icon, copy its file unchanged from the same version.
